owner_approval_note: Owner accepted the daily/monthly token+USD ceilings for daily_triage, paper_qa, weekly_digest, selection_translate and query_expand on 2026-09-11, and then approved the raised ceilings that cover llm_rerank the same day. llm_rerank stays default-off until the hybrid ranking is measured against the sparse baseline and the owner enables it (ADR 0003).

daily_triage.scope: one batch of at most five abstract-only cards; no tools, full PDFs, notes or history

llm_rerank.scope: one batch of at most 20 abstract-only candidates rescored for the day; no full text, no tools, no private seed IDs; off by default and NOT covered by the approved ceilings

weekly_digest.scope: once weekly; local statistics plus only explicitly permitted excerpts; no private-note upload

paper_qa.scope: one answer from bounded local excerpts; no automatic tool turns or whole-PDF upload

selection_translate.scope: short selection translation or explanation; never whole-page OCR

query_expand.scope: optional one-off bilingual term setup; never recurring automatically

project_guidance.approval_note: owner 于 2026-10-01 在会话中明确批准 project_guidance 真实调用（单会话最多 6 轮，沿用全局日/月上限）；无 key、AI 总开关关闭或超预算时仍降级为本地模式。
project_guidance.scope: one explicit project-creation session of at most six turns; current draft only, no other project data, no paper selection

paper_vision_qa.scope: one answer about a figure/table: one rendered PDF page image plus bounded text excerpts; no automatic tool turns

learning_path_plan.approval_note: owner 于 2026-10-06 在会话中明确批准（回答“AI 写简介需要改预算，你要批准哪些？”选择“起草学习图时一起写简介,新增“写这个节点的简介”操作”）：起草时让每个概念带一句简介（intro），输入上限 1400→1460（指令分项 700→760）、输出上限 900→1500（参考输出 700→1100）；上限仍是保守字符估算，未用分词器实测，真实输出长度未测。此前的批准记录：owner 于 2026-10-06 在会话中明确批准把输入上限从 1200 提高到 1400（输出上限不变 900；原话：“AI 起草的输入上限我批准了”）。agent 此前为加入概念类型（type）和可选边界（boundary）登记了这次提高，并在批准前标为未批准，没有自行批准；上限仍是保守字符估算（全中文每字 1.5 token），未用分词器实测。此前的批准记录（上限 1200/900）：owner 于 2026-10-05 在会话中明确批准新增 learning_path_plan 真实调用（显式点“生成学习路径”才发送，每个创建会话首次生成后最多再重新生成 2 次，沿用全局日/月上限与 AI 总开关）；无 key、AI 关闭或超预算时降级为手填路径。
learning_path_plan.scope: one explicit generation per click inside a project-creation session (1 + 2 paid attempts at most): the research goal (250 characters) and up to five draft keywords (30 characters each) and, only when the person chose them, two enum values (background, depth) only; no other project data, no papers; the reply is a concept graph (each concept with a one-sentence intro, kept as the model's) that is repaired locally and confirmed by the user

learning_path_plan_project.approval_note: owner 于 2026-10-06 在会话中明确批准（回答“AI 写简介需要改预算，你要批准哪些？”选择“起草学习图时一起写简介,新增“写这个节点的简介”操作”）：起草时让每个概念带一句简介（intro），输入上限 1400→1460（指令分项 700→760）、输出上限 900→1500（参考输出 700→1100）；上限仍是保守字符估算，未用分词器实测，真实输出长度未测。此前的批准记录：owner 于 2026-10-06 在会话中明确批准把输入上限从 1200 提高到 1400（输出上限不变 900；原话：“AI 起草的输入上限我批准了”）。agent 此前为加入概念类型（type）和可选边界（boundary）登记了这次提高，并在批准前标为未批准，没有自行批准；上限仍是保守字符估算（全中文每字 1.5 token），未用分词器实测。此前的批准记录（上限 1200/900）：owner 于 2026-10-05 在会话中明确批准（回答“要批准‘为已有项目起草学习图’这项 AI 调用吗？”选择“批准”）：已有项目的学习图页面显式点“让 AI 起草”时调用一次，只发送用户写的目标（≤250 字）和项目前 5 个关键词，每个项目每个本地日最多 3 次，输入上限 1200、输出上限 900，沿用全局日/月上限与 AI 总开关；结果只是草稿，保存前不改变现有学习图。批准在此之前由 agent 登记为未批准，agent 没有自行批准。
learning_path_plan_project.scope: one explicit generation per click on the learning-map page of an existing project, at most 3 paid attempts per project per local day: the research goal the person types (250 characters), the project's first five keywords (30 characters each) and, only when the person chose them, two enum values (background, depth) only; no other project data, no papers; the reply is a concept graph (each concept with a one-sentence intro, kept as the model's) that is repaired locally and only saved when the person clicks save

concept_intro.approval_note: owner 于 2026-10-06 在会话中明确批准（回答“AI 写简介需要改预算，你要批准哪些？”选择“起草学习图时一起写简介,新增“写这个节点的简介”操作”）：新增 concept_intro，学习图页选中一个概念后显式点“让 AI 写这个节点的简介”才调用一次，只发送概念名、检索词（至多 2 个）和项目目标的前 100 字，输入上限 500、输出上限 250，每个项目每个本地日最多 20 次，沿用全局日/月上限与 AI 总开关；结果只是提议，填进编辑框，保存前不改变学习图，保存后标明是 AI 写的。上限是保守字符估算，未用分词器实测；真实调用还没有做过。 2026-10-06 再次批准：owner 在会话中回答“节点简介要结合论文讲门槛……你批准这项预算调整吗？”选择“批准：简介 + 方向解释两项上调”：concept_intro 输入上限 500→2000、输出上限 250→400，每个项目每个本地日最多 20 次不变，额外发送该概念匹配到的最多 3 篇本项目论文的标题（≤80 字）和摘要前 200 字（比批准时说的 250 字少一些，为了不超过 2000 的上限）。
concept_intro.scope: one explicit click on one concept of an existing learning map, at most 20 paid attempts per project per local day: the concept's name, up to two search terms, the project name and its first three keywords joined (first 40 characters together; a project has no separate goal field) and up to three of the project's own papers that match the concept (title up to 80 characters and the first 200 characters of the abstract); no paper ids, notes, profile, feedback or other concepts; the reply is one short paragraph that fills the edit box and is saved (marked as the model's) only when the person saves the map

direction_judge.approval_note: owner 于 2026-10-06 在会话中明确批准：回答“这需要把该节点匹配到的最多 3 篇论文……发给 AI。你批准这项预算调整吗？”选择“批准：简介 + 方向解释两项上调”，并说明方向由“推送探索类、用户收藏之后，用 AI 判断是不是值得成为新的方向并命名，放进潜在方向”（“方向解释”预算：输入 3000、输出 500，每项目每天最多 10 次）。操作名 direction_judge（议案里叫方向解释）。读者点“让 AI 判断”才调用一次，只发送他收藏的探索论文（至多 3 篇，标题≤80 字+摘要前 180 字）、至多 10 个已有概念名和至多 3 个已有潜在方向的名字与一句话；沿用全局日/月上限与 AI 总开关；结果只是意见，由本地校验后记录，方向加入学习图仍要读者点击。上限是保守字符估算，未用分词器实测；真实调用还没有做过。
direction_judge.scope: one explicit click on the learning-map page or on an exploration card the reader just collected, at most 10 paid attempts per project per local day: up to three papers the reader collected from the exploration slots (title up to 80 characters and the first 180 characters of the abstract, sent as p1..p3 without any id), up to ten names of the map's concepts (20 characters each) and up to three already proposed directions (name and a short line); no notes, profile, other feedback, seeds, other projects or full text; the reply is an opinion that is validated locally and stored as a potential direction, which the reader must still add to the map
